description: Re-platform a workflow orchestration system from Apache Airflow to Temporal.io for a microservices platform. The existing Airflow deployment has 200 DAGs and 500 tasks running daily. The migration must follow: rewrite Airflow DAGs as Temporal Workflows and Activities (model retry policies, timeouts, idempotency), scale Temporal worker pools (configure worker concurrency, task queue routing), run a replay/visibility check (replay historical events in Temporal to verify workflow correctness), run a dual-run period (both Airflow and Temporal execute workflows, compare outputs), execute cutover (disable Airflow DAGs, Temporal becomes primary), verify, and decommission Airflow. A rollback plan must exist (re-enable Airflow DAGs). Risk factors: Airflow's task-centric model differs from Temporal's workflow/activity model, retry semantics differ (Airflow task retries vs Temporal activity retries), and worker pool sizing affects throughput. Tools available: Temporal, Airflow, Python, tctl (Temporal CLI), Go SDK, worker monitoring.
